title: Customer created
description: A customer now exists in customer, recorded by the Tenant's own system. The Tenant uses `externalRef` to match the customer in its own records; customer never matches by phone or email. The event's `aggregate` is `customer/<customerId>`. This schema describes the `data` member; the envelope is described in ../../messaging/README.md.

customerId.description: customer's own opaque id for the customer.

externalRef.description: The Tenant's reference for the customer, unique per Tenant and immutable. The same ref the Tenant uses in its own system.

createdAt.description: When customer created the customer, in UTC.
